VlocityDataPackData.Name: DR-Transform-KycTransform
VlocityDataPackData.Description: Transforms raw data from two sources into the normalized KYC request payload: (1) OmniScript form data (personal info, SSN), (2) Credit Bureau API response (score, band, factors). Output feeds into DR-Load-ClientProfileLoad and the OmniScript review step.

Transformations.name: NormalizePersonalInfo
Transformations.description: Normalizes OmniScript personal info fields into a canonical PersonalInfo block for downstream DR Load and IP steps.

fieldTransforms.comment: Used in OFAC check payload and display labels
OmniScript DatePicker outputs MM/DD/YYYY; KYC API expects ISO 8601
Calculated age for under-18 validation in IP
Strip hyphens: 123-45-6789 → 123456789. Stored as 9-digit string for KYC API.
Display-safe SSN: ***-**-6789 for review step and advisor view
Normalize email to lowercase before upsert to avoid case-mismatch duplicates
Ensure state abbreviation is uppercase (CA not ca)
Trim ZIP+4 (10001-1234) to 5-digit form for address validation API

Transformations.name: NormalizeCreditBureauResponse
Transformations.description: Maps the raw Credit Bureau API JSON response to the internal CreditProfile structure used by OmniScript display, DataRaptor Load, and Integration Procedure context.

fieldTransforms.comment: API returns numeric score; ensure integer type for Salesforce Number field
Normalize band to uppercase (EXCELLENT, VERY_GOOD, GOOD, FAIR, POOR)
Human-readable label for OmniScript display and advisor FlexCard
Pre-computed boolean flag consumed by IP conditional logic
Take only the top 3 factors for display — API may return up to 10
Joined string for OmniScript text display: 'PAYMENT_HISTORY, UTILIZATION, ACCOUNT_AGE'

Transformations.name: BuildKycApiRequest
Transformations.description: Assembles the outbound KYC / OFAC API request payload from normalized personal info. Used by the ClientOnboardingIP HTTP callout step.

fieldTransforms.comment: 9-digit SSN without hyphens per KYC API spec

Transformations.name: BuildCreditApiRequest
Transformations.description: Assembles the outbound Credit Bureau API request payload.

fieldTransforms.comment: Salesforce Account Id passed in from OmniScript context
SOFT = soft pull (does not affect credit score). HARD = hard pull on loan offer acceptance.

Transformations.name: BuildOnboardingContextSummary
Transformations.description: Assembles the final onboarding context summary node for OmniScript review step and advisor notification email.

InputParameters.name: OmniScriptData
InputParameters.description: Raw OmniScript form data: FirstName, LastName, SSN, DateOfBirth, Email, Phone, State, ZipCode

InputParameters.name: CreditBureauApiResponse
InputParameters.description: Raw Credit Bureau API response: score, band, factors[]. May be null if credit check is skipped.

InputParameters.name: applicantSalesforceId
InputParameters.description: Salesforce Account Id — available after Account upsert in IP, passed back for credit API request

OutputParameters.name: NormalizedPersonalInfo
OutputParameters.description: Normalized personal info: trimmed names, ISO date, masked SSN, lowercase email, digits-only phone

OutputParameters.name: CreditProfile
OutputParameters.description: Normalized credit data: creditScore (Integer), creditBand, creditBandLabel, eligibilityFlags, topFactors

OutputParameters.name: OnboardingSummary
OutputParameters.description: Composite summary for OmniScript review display and advisor notification

interviewNotes.whyTransformDR: DataRaptor Transform performs field mapping, type coercion, string manipulation, and conditional logic without Apex code. This one DR replaces ~80 lines of Apex transformation methods. Admin-modifiable without deployment.
interviewNotes.ssnHandling: SSN is normalized (hyphens stripped) for the KYC API, masked (first 5 chars replaced with *) for display, but never stored in plaintext in Salesforce. The actual SSN from the OmniScript is only ever in memory during the Integration Procedure execution.
interviewNotes.dateFormatTransform: OmniScript DatePicker outputs MM/DD/YYYY; KYC and Credit APIs expect ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). The DateFormat transform handles this conversion declaratively. Without this DR, you'd need Apex date parsing code.
interviewNotes.lookupTransform: The creditBandLabel Lookup transform converts 'GOOD' → 'Good (670–739)' inline. This is a declarative value map — equivalent to an Apex Map<String,String> but admin-configurable.
interviewNotes.conditionTransform: eligibleForAutoApproval and eligibleForManualReview use Condition transforms (score >= 720, score >= 620) to produce Boolean flags. IP can then use these in Conditional steps instead of numeric comparisons.
interviewNotes.multiInputTransform: BuildOnboardingContextSummary takes two input paths (NormalizedPersonalInfo and CreditProfile). DataRaptor Transform supports merging multiple input nodes into a single output — equivalent to Apex object composition.
interviewNotes.executionOrder: In the ClientOnboardingIP: (1) NormalizePersonalInfo + BuildKycApiRequest → (2) KYC HTTP callout → (3) NormalizeCreditBureauResponse → (4) BuildCreditApiRequest → (5) Credit HTTP callout → (6) BuildOnboardingContextSummary → (7) DR-Load-ClientProfileLoad.
